summary: Security fix, upgrade soon if you use piiShield (0.24.2 only): a mention label over 120 code points could send a fragment of an e-mail, IBAN or phone number past the shield. The chat now leaves a value at the cut out whole; labels within the limit or cut in a plain word are unchanged.
howTo: Nothing to do in the React chat. Before: a value starting shortly before the cut reached the model as a plain-text fragment (max.musterm…, DE8937040…, +49 170 1…). Now, when the token at the cut or the first after it has a digit, @ / : + _ % = # & ~ \ | or a dot inside, it is left out with the value parts and separators before it (+49 170 1234567, DE89 3704 …); dates, times, prices, file names, paths and versions at the edge go too, a label full of numbers can shrink to its first word, one that is only a value becomes the id. mentions: { serialize: { labelCut: 'grapheme' } } keeps the 0.24.2 cut. Own clients or servers that call canonicalMentionLabel / serializeMentionMarker directly keep the 0.24.2 cut by default and opt in with cut: 'value-safe' / labelCut: 'value-safe'. Without upgrading: mentions: { serialize: { labels: 'raw' } } sends labels whole as 0.24.1 did (without the canonical cleaning); a lower maxLabelLength does not help. Known limits: text stored by a 0.24.2 client keeps its cut label; names or streets without digits cut inside a word; values a custom detector finds without any of those characters; 0.24.2 clients still running. See docs/chat-interactions.md, Mention markers.
